rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified 1.2 ha regeneration felling in Norrköping, status notified. No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0.0 ha), so it is not already felled.
No species records of any kind inside the polygon or within 250 m, so there is no eligible species within 250 m.

One eligible species lies beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Bryoria bicolor (EN lichen, forest-associated, site-bound). Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest and changed stand structure and tree-species composition. One record, 639 m away (2022, uncertainty 10 m). This triggers MEDIUM under the rubric.

Supporting context: several site-bound forest NT species (fungi and lichens) are recorded within 1000 m, the nearest being Hydnellum ferrugineum at 325 m (2024). None lie within 250 m, so the 3-species NT trigger is not met. Mobile birds are listed within 1000 m as supporting evidence only.

Effort is adequate: 245 records and 115 species within 1000 m against a county median of 149 (83rd percentile). But near-site effort is zero: no records inside the polygon or within 250 m, against a county median of 3 within 250 m.

contradictions.claim: Overall effort within 1000 m is well above the county median, yet near-site effort is zero records within 250 m. The empty near-site ring therefore reflects little recording at the site itself, not just a sparsely recorded area.

uncertainties: The EN Bryoria bicolor record is 639 m away and says little about the notified stand.
No near-site records exist, so the stand itself is effectively unsurveyed in public data.
All records come from Artportalen. They show a species was recorded, not that it occupies the site today.
not_established: That Bryoria bicolor or any threatened species occurs on the notified stand.
Absence of species inside the polygon, since having no records is not the same as having no species.
That the site is safe to fell, or any legal status of the species.
next_action: Ask a reviewer to check the 2022 Bryoria bicolor record (GBIF 5135083104) and the nearer NT fungus records against the polygon, and consider a field check of the stand because no near-site records exist.
